text: Planning a trip can be just as exciting as the journey itself. You spend hours researching destinations, booking flights, and creating a list of must-see places. However, the real magic begins when you step off the plane into a new culture. The unfamiliar sounds, sights, and smells are both thrilling and overwhelming. Of course, food is a major highlight, from street stalls to local restaurants, though ordering can be a gamble if you do not speak the language. Language barriers often lead to funny misunderstandings, but with gestures and smiles, you always manage. In the end, the best souvenirs are the memories you keep forever.
